author: Mark Atwood
text:
Architecture decisions locked in (2026-05-12, Mark):

## Decision A — Test infrastructure shape: Option C with sub-option C1

Add a new test-only backend in `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/common/mod.rs` alongside `FaultyBackend` and `TrackingBackend`. The new backend:
  - `type CallerCtx = Id`
  - `fn principal_id(caller: &Id) -> Option<&Id> { Some(caller) }`
  - Estimated ~150-200 LOC

`MemoryBackend` stays `type CallerCtx = ()`. The 309 existing `&()` call sites in `tests/integration.rs` and `tests/common/mod.rs` do NOT change.

To let the new test backend reuse `MemoryBackend`'s mutation logic, extract a `pub(crate)` helper:

```rust
pub(crate) fn apply_space_patch_with_caller_id(
    inner: &mut Inner,
    caller_id: Option<&Id>,
    account_id: &Id,
    space_id: &Id,
    ops: Vec<SpacePatchOp>,
) -> Result<Vec<OpResult>, BackendSetError<MemoryError>>
```

Both `MemoryBackend::apply_space_patch` and the new test backend's `apply_space_patch` delegate to this helper, each passing `Self::principal_id(caller)` (cloned/owned as needed). Inside the helper, `caller_id == None` means single-user mode (allow all identity-gated ops); `caller_id == Some(id)` exercises the full enforcement path (criteria 1-3 of the re-scoped acceptance).

This honors the workspace AGENTS.md 'Caller identity (foundation seam)' guidance: 'Test fixtures and single-user dev servers use the default None-returning impl and are fine; multi-user production deployments MUST override.'

## Decision B — protect_last_admin shape: Option B1 (trait method)

Add to `ChatBackend` trait:

```rust
fn protect_last_admin(&self, caller: &Self::CallerCtx, account_id: &Id) -> bool {
    let _ = (caller, account_id);
    true
}
```

Default `true` so any third-party backend that doesn't override gets production-safe behavior.

`MemoryBackend` overrides to return `inner.protect_last_admin` (a new bool on `Inner`, default `false` for backward compat with existing tests). Add a `#[doc(hidden)] pub fn set_protect_last_admin_for_test(&self, value: bool)` on `MemoryBackend` matching the existing test-setter precedent (e.g., `set_limits_for_test`).

Same shape as `ChatBackend::limits` precedent. The 'single bool doesn't fit ChatLimits' concern is acknowledged but not addressed now; if we accumulate more policy bools we can roll them into a `ChatPolicies` struct later.

## Implementation order

  1. Add `ChatBackend::protect_last_admin` trait method (default `true`)
  2. Add `protect_last_admin: bool` to `MemoryBackend::Inner` (default `false`) + `set_protect_last_admin_for_test` setter
  3. Extract `apply_space_patch_with_caller_id` pub(crate) helper from current `MemoryBackend::apply_space_patch`
  4. Implement Role + Member variants in the helper with full criteria 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 enforcement (criterion 7 single-user-mode handling already falls out naturally since `caller_id == None` skips identity checks)
  5. Add identity-bearing test backend to `tests/common/mod.rs`
  6. Add integration tests covering: hierarchy enforcement, cascade-to-everyone on RemoveRole, last-admin protection with the knob on and off, single-user-mode (caller_id == None) allowing all ops, whole-patch reject on permission failure

## Ready for pickup

The 'human' label can be removed. /do-beads can claim this bead next pass.
